title: Sessions an agent opens appear in the grid on screen without clicking the project

requirements.text: The join decision is a pure function in GenlockCore, and an agent-opened session joins when the screen shows one pane of its own project
A project grid already showing 6 or more panes (up to SplitLayout.maxPanes) still takes a new agent-opened session
Command-N with one pane on screen still opens the new session alone (unchanged)
The app builds and the full Core test suite passes

evidence: swift test --filter GridJoinTests: 6 passed; testAgentOpenJoinsTheOnePaneOfItsProject -> index 1
testCommandNWithOnePaneStillOpensAlone -> nil with beside:false; newSession call site unchanged (AppModel.swift:848)
swift build: Build complete; swift test: 183 tests, 0 failures, 1 skipped

text: Fix in, 183 tests pass. Not yet seen in the relaunched app: TJ relaunches and has a session run genlock open --prompt.

fields.symptom: A session opened by an agent (genlock open, or an Assistant) did not appear in the grid; it showed only after clicking the project
fields.root_cause: joinGridIfShowing required 2+ panes on screen and capped at DashSelection.maxPanes=6 while project grids hold SplitLayout.maxPanes=12
whys: the one-pane rule was written for Command-N and reused for agent opens, where the one pane is the asker itself
two pane caps exist and the join used the hand-marking one
fields.corrective: SplitLayout.joinIndex in Core with beside: for agent opens; cap = SplitLayout.maxPanes, also for spin-offs
fields.preventive: GridJoinTests covers one pane, 6+ panes, Command-N

answers.cause: measurement for the rule (read the guard at AppModel.swift:875: visible.count > 1 and DashSelection.maxPanes); hypothesis that this is what TJ hit, since not reproduced in the live app
answers.absence: no other code path adds agent-opened sessions to visible besides joinGridIfShowing and the spin-off path (grep visible.insert/append)
answers.assumption: TJ was looking at one session (or a 6+ pane grid) of the same project when it opened; if he was viewing another project, it still correctly stays out
answers.falsify: relaunch, have a lone session run genlock open --prompt; if no second pane appears, the cause is elsewhere
